actions.name: Petrifying Bite
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit:
3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11. First Failure: The target has the

actions.name: Restrained condition
actions.description: The target repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the Petrified condition, instead of the Restrained condition, for 24 hours.
